aj: Heads-up: I'm kicking off an apples-to-apples bench comparing replay vs synthetic for continuous batching fairness. Plan and quick sanity checks below.

maya: paste it here pls

aj: TL;DR plan: two traffic modes (replay with tenant weights from prod, synth seeded with same length histogram + Poisson+microbursts jitter). Toggle kernel selection (auto vs forced fast-attn), vary kv-cache states (cold / warmed / uniform-warmup), sweep batch_cap {32,64,128} and max_delay_ms {5,10,25}. Record p50/p95/p99, throughput (tokens/sec), batch_size_hist, per-tenant tail, kv_hit_rate, kernel-switch-rate, kernel_selected logs.

sam: add prefix-cache-only true/false runs? we've had prefix-only skew before

aj: done. also plan 3 seeds per config, 30m runs, preserve inter-arrival jitter for replay (--preserve-jitter true).

lin: capture kernel-switch events and per-request kernel_selected from runtime logs so we can compute kernel-switch-rate per minute.

aj: example harness config i'll pass:
```json
{
  "traffic_mode": "replay",
  "tenant_weights": "from-prod-1w",
  "batch_cap": 64,
  "max_delay_ms": 10,
  "kernel_override": "auto",
  "kv_warmup_requests": 10000,
  "prefix_cache_only": false
}
```

maya: make sure synth uses same length distribution as replay otherwise apples-to-apples fails

aj: yep, synth seeded from replay histogram.

(ci-bot): baseline artifacts copied from s3://redwood-perf/baseline/1987580000

deploy-bot: CI trigger: perf-harness/1987654321 started by aj 4BB job ph-1987654321

aj: early warmup note: after kv_warmup_requests=10k, kv_hit_rate ~0.63 for tenant-weighted replay. uniform-warmup variant queued to measure skew effects.

sam: recall when batch_cap=128 we saw starvation for small-req tenants. add unfairness metric: per-tenant p90/p10 ratio or p95/p10.

aj: proposing unfairness_index = median(tenant p95) / median(tenant p10). lin suggests p90/p10 less noisy. we'll report both.

maya: small local run: forced fast-attn reduced avg latency ~8ms but bumped p99 for small tenants.

aj: hypothesis: fast-attn interacts poorly with KV-miss paths or changes batching thresholds. we'll correlate kernel_selected with kv_hit boolean.

lin: runtime logs contain kernel_selected per request_id; also capture seq_len, active_kv_size, and kv_hit flag.

aj: enabling those fields. also adding kernel_switch_rate metric (switches/min per model+seqlen bucket).

sam: propose adding new kernel selector hyperparam kv_miss_penalty and sweep {0,1.5,3.0} to bias against kernels that pay heavy cost on misses.

aj: queued. also trying batch_cap=32 to see fairness vs throughput tradeoff. initial quick results: batch_cap=32 reduced unfairness but lowered throughput ~9%.

aj: interim summary (batch_cap=64, max_delay=10, replay vs synth):
- replay p99 = 212 ms, synth p99 = 205 ms
- replay avg_batch = 41, synth avg_batch = 44
- replay unfairness_index (p90/p10) = 2.8, synth = 1.9
- kv_hit_rate_replay = 0.62, kv_hit_rate_synth = 0.78
- fallback_kernel_pct replay ~= 18%, synth ~= 4%

maya: replay worse unfairness. suggests skewed tenant warmups and KV misses dominate over pure batching policy.

lin: kernel_selected logs show fallback mapped strongly to requests with large past-key values and kv_miss=true. Looks like the selector underestimates cost when kv_miss is likely.

aj: next experiment: add kv_miss_penalty to kernel scoring and sweep. also test max_delay_ms=5 to favor small-tenant latency.

sam: include rollback criteria in RFC: delta p99 > 10% absolute for any tenant OR unfairness increase > 0.5.

aj: agreed. s3 artifact path: s3://redwood-perf/continuous-batching/exp-1987654321/{replay|synth}/{config_hash}/{seed}/

ops: please schedule cluster-wide 128-cap runs only during 02:00-06:00 UTC window.

aj: scheduled for 03:00 UTC.

(ci-bot): job ph-1987654321: step 1 done (warmup).

aj: inserting small CSV excerpt for quick view:

```
config,batch_cap,max_delay_ms,p99_replay,p99_synth,unfairness_replay,kv_hit_replay,throughput_replay
base,64,10,212,205,2.8,0.62,93.4
lowcap,32,10,198,199,1.6,0.59,84.9
kvpenalty-1.5,64,10,205,204,2.1,0.65,91.7
```

maya: kvpenalty looks promising (reduced unfairness). any perf cost? throughput slightly down but p99 improved for small tenants.

aj: yes throughput delta small, fairness improved. planning RFC: recommend kernel selector include kv_miss_penalty default=1.5 and canary at 5% traffic for 24h. include rollback criteria.

lin: add instrumentation dashboard showing kernel-switch-rate + per-tenant tail and kv_hit distribution.

aj: will draft RFC and attach experiment artifacts and reproducibility steps (2-3 commands).

maya: please include exact harness commands so engs can reproduce locally.

aj: will post gist link in this thread when ready.

deploy-bot: perf-harness/1987654321 finished. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/continuous-batching/exp-1987654321/

aj: thanks everyone. closing thread after RFC posted.
